package mini

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

// Call overhead on arm64: a loop in a unified entry calling, each iteration,
// either a register-entry leaf (direct BL, no stub) or a non-leaf unified
// callee through the call_ stub that saves and restores R19-R25 and F8-F15.
// The difference is the unified-call overhead: the stub plus the callee's
// own split prologue. Built with CONV_NO_SAVES, the stub skips the saves, so
// that run isolates the pure 15-register save/restore cost. nsPerCall reports
// the minimum of several timed runs.
func TestCallOverhead(t *testing.T) {
	const n = 300_000_000
	cases := []struct {
		name          string
		reg, uni      func(ssp, n uint64) uint64
		wantReg, want uint64
	}{
		{"int", c_bench_reg_i, c_bench_uni_i, 0, 0},
		{"double", c_bench_reg_d, c_bench_uni_d, 0, 0},
	}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		c.wantReg = c.reg(0, 8)
		c.want = c.uni(4096, 8)
	}
	nsPerCall := func(f func(ssp, n uint64) uint64, ssp uint64) (float64, uint64) {
		best := 1e30
		var r uint64
		for round := 0; round < 7; round++ {
			t0 := nowNanos()
			r = f(ssp, n)
			if d := float64(nowNanos()-t0) / float64(n); d < best {
				best = d
			}
		}
		return best, r
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		reg, rr := nsPerCall(c.reg, 0)
		uni, ur := nsPerCall(c.uni, 4096)
		fmt.Printf("%-7s register=%.3f ns  unified=%.3f ns  delta=%.3f ns  (reg sum %d uni sum %d)\n",
			c.name, reg, uni, uni-reg, rr, ur)
	}
}
